shells.command: until [ -s ".cache/txt/Thinking with Type _ A Critical Guide for Designers.txt" ] && grep -q "ALL OCR COMPLETE" .cache/ocr.log; do sleep 20; done; echo "OCR finished"; wc -c .cache/txt/*.txt | sort -n
